AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Enabled.Name: Enable AAGM-O bridge
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Enabled.Hint: Connect this Foundry tab to the local AAGM-O relay. Disable to fully close the WebSocket.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.RelayUrl.Name: Relay URL
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.RelayUrl.Hint: Local AAGM-O WebSocket URL. Default: ws://127.0.0.1:7888. Remote URLs are refused by design.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.MenuHint: Mode presets, multitasking, and the local Macro Mirror.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Modeassistant.Name: Assistant Mode
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Modeassistant.Hint: AAGM assists at your table. Automatic rollback points protect supported writes. (Default)
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Modecogm.Name: Co-GM Mode
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Modecogm.Hint: AAGM works alongside you with multitasking. Assumes an experienced GM.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Modecustom.Name: Custom
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.OptsLegend: Options (set by the mode unless Custom)
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Multitasking.Name: Agentic multitasking
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Multitasking.Hint: Shows one task per chat tab. A capable Codex client may run a background agent for each tab.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.MirrorEnabled.Name: Macros Mirrored Locally?
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.MirrorEnabled.Hint: Lets Codex back up world macros beneath a local relay folder and restore from it. Backups never delete files.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.MirrorPath.Name: Local directory:
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.MirrorSort.Name: Use Contextual sorting? (Experimental)
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.MirrorSort.Hint: Match normalized Foundry folder names to local folders. No confident match creates the literal sanitized folder name.
AAGM_O.SETTINGS.Saved: AAGM-O settings saved and synced to the relay.
AAGM_O.NOTIFY.Refused: AAGM-O bridge refused by relay. Check the capability configuration.
AAGM_O.NOTIFY.SecondListener: A second AAGM-O listener was refused because one is already active.
AAGM_O.CHAT.Title: AAGM-O Chat
AAGM_O.CHAT.NotConnected: AAGM-O cannot reach the local relay.
AAGM_O.CHAT.StatusNoListener: Connected to the relay, but no Codex or ChatGPT listener is polling. Messages will queue.
AAGM_O.CHAT.StatusDisconnected: Lost connection to the relay. Confirm the relay is running and the bridge is enabled.
AAGM_O.CHAT.Placeholder: Type a message. /int uses Foundry, /ext uses outside Codex, and /exit stops the listener.
AAGM_O.CHAT.ReplyWhileClosed: AAGM-O replied while the chat box was closed. Reopen "Open AAGM-O Chat" to continue.
AAGM_O.CHAT.ModeInternal: Internal mode: chat runs in Foundry.
AAGM_O.CHAT.ModeExternal: External mode: use Codex outside Foundry.
AAGM_O.CHAT.Interrupt: Interrupt sent to the active task.
AAGM_O.CHAT.RollbackPartial: Rollback partial: some documents were not restored.
AAGM_O.CHAT.RollbackWhileClosed: Rollback event while the chat box is closed. Reopen the chat to see it.
AAGM_O.CHAT.TabAdd: New tab (5 max). One tab = one task.
AAGM_O.CHAT.TabClose: Close tab (stops its task). Typing /close does the same.
AAGM_O.LOOT.Armed: AAGM-O Loot Watchdog ARMED. Run the macro again to disarm.
AAGM_O.LOOT.NoJournal: AAGM-O Loot Watchdog: rescue log journal not found at
AAGM_O.LOOT.NoItemPiles: AAGM-O Loot Watchdog requires the Item Piles module.
AAGM_O.LOOT.Vanish: LOOT WATCHDOG: an item vanished in transfer. Queued for Codex auto-restore. See the Rescue Log.
AAGM_O.LOOT.Phantom: LOOT WATCHDOG: phantom 'trait as loot' detected. Held for review. See the Rescue Log.
